topic: How does the 41% efficiency of the proposed antenna impact link budget calculations for GEO-LEO satellite links?
consensus_response: The 41% efficiency directly impacts link budget calculations by reducing available power, increasing interference, and degrading signal-to-noise ratio. This translates to reduced achievable data rates and increased latency due to amplified path loss in GEO-LEO links. Antenna phase and polarization become crucial for mitigating these effects. Adaptive antenna designs and dynamic beamforming are necessary to ensure reliable communication across varying atmospheric conditions.
reference_context: Satellite link budgets must consider power constraints of the satellite, gateway, and user equipment (UE). The efficiency of the proposed antenna directly impacts the achievable data rates and latency in GEO-LEO links.  The higher radiated power density increases noise levels and interference, requiring larger antennas for compensation.
